# File Specifications

## `src/app/globals.css`

- Action: Modify
- Purpose: Become the semantic design-token and layout-foundation source of truth for the app.
- Responsibility: Define app-wide color roles, text roles, surface roles, spacing/layout rhythm, border/radius choices, and motion-safe defaults that can be consumed across user-facing routes.
- Public API: Global CSS variables, Tailwind-adjacent utility patterns, and baseline global rules available to every route/component.
- Inputs: Existing Tailwind v4 setup, current home-route visual language, and `next/font` variables from `src/app/layout.tsx`.
- Outputs: Reusable semantic tokens and baseline layout behavior suitable for `/` now and browse/detail routes later.
- Dependencies: Tailwind v4 `@theme inline`, font variables from `src/app/layout.tsx`.
- Rendering mode: Global stylesheet.
- State ownership: None.
- Data fetching / mutation strategy: None.
- Loading / error / empty states: Not applicable.
- Test impact: Visual regressions will be browser-facing rather than unit-centric; deterministic validation remains lint/build plus manual route review.
- Verification expectations: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, and manual checks for contrast, focus visibility, reduced motion, and responsive spacing.
- Open decisions: Whether the token system remains token-first only or also supports a small shared UI/system layer.

## `src/components/ui/*` or `src/components/system/*`

- Action: Create (recommended if shared-layer option is chosen)
- Purpose: Hold the smallest useful set of reusable visual building blocks for current and future user-facing routes.
- Responsibility: Encapsulate repeated visual structure such as section containers, heading blocks, card/panel wrappers, and CTA/link treatments without becoming a speculative full component library.
- Public API: Named presentational components with explicit variants or slots; intended consumers are route-level section components.
- Inputs: Semantic tokens from `src/app/globals.css`, plain props, optional children composition.
- Outputs: Stateless JSX wrappers or helpers that reduce repeated structural styling across route components.
- Dependencies: React Server Component-compatible modules, Tailwind classes, semantic CSS variables.
- Rendering mode: Server Component modules by default.
- State ownership: None expected.
- Data fetching / mutation strategy: None.
- Loading / error / empty states: Not applicable for presentational primitives.
- Test impact: No immediate test additions expected; eventual Playwright/browser validation is more valuable than Vitest for this layer.
- Verification expectations: Shared components import cleanly into home-route consumers, keep class repetition down, and preserve accessible semantics/focus behavior.
- Open decisions: Whether to stop at tokens only or introduce this shared layer now; exact file split should remain minimal and repetition-driven.
